_readme: Regular clients: named men who keep coming back to a house, usually for one favorite lady.

A good visit can turn a client into a regular (up to max per house). Each regular visits most weeks, asks for his favorite, and pays with his quirk's tip multiplier. Bad visits wear his loyalty down until he stops coming.
quirks: label and desc show in the Houses tab. tip multiplies what he pays. drama = chance per week of his quirk's event (text in events below).
events: {name} = the lady, {regular} = his name, {house} = the house, {gold} = money involved. Choice logic is in js/events/regulars.js; the words are all here.

lingering.label: Lingers
lingering.desc: Never wants the night to end.

smitten.label: Smitten
smitten.desc: Has fallen for his favorite. Might try to take her away.

talker.label: Talker
talker.desc: Mostly comes for conversation, and tells everyone about the house.

shy.label: Shy
shy.desc: Took him weeks to say hello. Very loyal once he does.

new: {regular} keeps asking for {name}. Looks like he's a regular now.

generous.title: A Gift for {name}
text: {regular} arrived with a velvet box for {name}: a bracelet worth at least {gold}. She's turning it over in her hands, delighted and a little unsure.
generous.keep: She keeps it. She hasn't stopped smiling.
generous.split: She hands it to Sam to sell for the house, a little wistfully. +{gold}.

jealous.title: {regular} Wants {name} to Himself
text: {regular} saw {name} going upstairs with someone else, and he's at the front desk, red in the face. He wants her to see no one else on his nights, and he'll pay for it.
jealous.pay: He pays {gold} for his nights to be hers alone. {name} rolls her eyes but takes the money.
jealous.refuse: Sam tells him {name} isn't anyone's property. {regular} storms out. He may not come back.
jealous.calm: {name} talks him down herself, sweetly. He leaves soothed, and she leaves tired.

lingering.title: {regular} Won't Leave
text: It's past dawn and {regular} is still in {name}'s room, talking about his mother.
lingering.charge: Sam bills him for the whole night. He pays {gold} without blinking. {name} is exhausted.
lingering.escort: Security walks him out, politely. He's embarrassed, and a little hurt.
lingering.letit: Sam lets it go. {name} gets no sleep, but {regular} tips extra out of guilt.

smitten.title: {regular} Proposes
text: {regular} has offered to buy out {name}'s contract and marry her. He's put {gold} on the table and is waiting for an answer.
smitten.stays: {name} looks at the money, then at Sam, and gently tells {regular} no. She's staying.
smitten.goes: {name} hesitates a long time, then says yes. She leaves with {regular}, and the house keeps the {gold}.
smitten.refuse: Sam refuses the offer outright. {regular} leaves, heartbroken. {name} looks relieved, and a little annoyed nobody asked her.

talker.title: {regular} Spreads the Word
text: {regular} has been telling everyone in town about {house}, and about {name} in particular. A few new faces have turned up asking for her.
talker.thanks: Sam stands him a drink. Reputation +2.
